title: Prediction
description: Predict what a dynamic route parameter represents.
prompt: In the route /lessons/:lessonSlug, what does lessonSlug represent?

options.label: The changing value from the URL that identifies the requested lesson.
The React component name that should be rendered.
A local state variable that stores which button was clicked.

responses.component-name: Not quite. The route element chooses the component. The parameter is the value from the URL.
responses.url-value: Correct. A URL parameter captures a dynamic part of the path so the page can identify the requested resource.
responses.local-state: Not quite. The URL already carries the identity, so the page should read it from route params.

metadata.reason: Catches confusion between URL identity, component selection, and local state.
